card.name: Open parenthesis before section numbers
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis that starts a cross-reference to a label section number, such as (7) or (5.8), usually at the end of a clause in a highlights or warnings list.

modes.label: Section cross-reference
modes.description: A parenthesis opens a numbered reference to another label section after a drug or warning phrase.

modes.label: Bracketed see-references
modes.description: A parenthesis follows a section name like Drug Interactions or Overdosage inside a [see ...] note.

modes.label: Symbol lists
modes.description: A parenthesis appears in a list of characters in non-label help text.
